Ticket 17 — is the base/cluster split the detector you want?

Two questions, 75 cards. Grade top to bottom; nothing on a card says which detector it came from.

1 — the names (60 cards)

Plain candles, §2's moving averages, no drawn base and no trigger — a drawn base would tell you which detector picked the card. Grade each one the way you graded round 2: 1 = not a setup, 5 = exactly the continuation setup you want. You are answering: would I want this name on tonight's list?

2 — the drawings (15 cards)

The same bars drawn twice, at the same scale, by the two detectors. Shaded blue is the base; shaded gold, where present, is the tight cluster inside it. The gold line is that detector's upper boundary, green dashed its trigger, red dashed its stop. Which side is which is randomised per card. Pick the drawing that describes the setup you would actually trade — neither is a real answer.

1–5 or a/b/n answer and advance · j/k move · grades are saved in the browser, and export at the bottom emits the string to paste back
